kind: Provenance index for selected sanitized derived evidence

availability.included: Only generator.json, validation.json and this index are exported. These are derived summaries, not unchanged original receipts.
availability.not_included: Raw model sessions, native reports, source snapshots, complete CI manifest, runner, fixture/protocol originals and credential material remain outside this public bundle.
availability.reproducibility: Original SHA-256 values bind maintainer-local provenance but do not make unavailable raw evidence publicly reproducible or independently attest local execution. Relative cache IDs are identifiers, not repository links.
availability.mutability: Original receipts were read and hashed without modification. This derived bundle does not authorize publication or attest a future release candidate.
